convars.description:
This string is prefixed to the name of all bots that join the game.
<difficulty> will be replaced with the bot's difficulty.
<weaponclass> will be replaced with the bot's desired weapon class.
<skill> will be replaced with a 0-100 representation of the bot's skill.
convars.name: bot_prefix

convars.description: How many minutes each round takes.
convars.name: mp_roundtime

convars.description: Allows team members to injure other members of their team
convars.name: mp_friendlyfire

convars.description: Draw fps meter at top of screen (1 = fps, 2 = smooth fps, 3 = server MS, 4 = Show FPS and Log to file )
convars.name: cl_showfps

convars.description: max number of rounds to play before server changes maps
convars.name: mp_maxrounds

convars.description: Prescale the clock by this amount.
convars.name: host_timescale

convars.name: mp_retake_ct_loadout_default_pistol_round
